run_create_uma_finetune_dataset_cli: run the CLI to process ASE atoms objects and generate UMA fine-tuning YAML configs from train and val directories
create_yaml_finetune_configs: create YAML config files for UMA model fine-tuning by populating templates with dataset paths and normalizer values
launch_processing_ase_atoms: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms objects from a directory into the fairchem dataset format
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data
review_create_yaml_function: review the create_yaml function that generates uma_sm_finetune_template.yaml and data task YAML configs for fine-tuning
